H2.why: Better: 20% shorter, handoffs recorded, the summary matches the helper, the what-ifs reproduce, and the cut of ticketing is honestly evidenced. Worse: phase 1 now has no Jira work at all (r7 had drafting). The gold-question wait was dropped from the schedule, and the pilot has no calendar time. Either one, modelled, turns 'fits' into 'low end only', so the headline rests on omissions again (r7: on missing handoffs). Rollback is gone entirely.

H4.why: Handoff mechanics are fixed and every quoted figure reproduces. But 'fits' rests on a silent rise from 5 to 6 focused h/day: at 5.5 h it does not fit, and there is no A2 what-if. Before live customers there is no real booking-API test, no production-environment goal, no kill switch or drills, and no enforcement of the pilot-salon limit. Both W1 claims are inaccurate (one too pessimistic, one wrong about what moves). Length went up, not down, and the over-budget words are history tables and pasted output while safety content was cut.

top_issues: The rule moved the gap rather than closing it. With handoff hours now recorded, the 'fits' headlines rest on other unmodelled prose: H2's gold-question wait and pilot days (each flips it to low end only), and H4's hours-per-day assumption (5.5 h already fails)

Prose dependencies and approvals still escape the block: H4 G07 and G06 need G04; G08 and G09 approvals; H2 A5 and project/IAP authorization. A lint for 'once X lands', 'needs approval' or 'from <person>' in tickets would catch most of them

Silent losses between rounds continue: H2 lost Jira drafting and rollback; H4 lost the kill switch, drills, the staging booking-API journey and the per-salon restriction. The budget rule says not to cut these, but they went while history tables and pasted output stayed
Neither design meets 'at most half': 2,790 and 2,988 words against ~2,000. Both are still written at production granularity
Helper gaps: 'handoff: 0' silences the cross-person warning, one handoff value covers many givers, and there is no check that handoff hours are inside total
Unchanged capacity assumptions between rounds (H4 5 -> 6 h/day) need a sensitivity row like H2's 2.4 h/day one
